youtube.title: Why Your Tongue Sticks to Frozen Metal 🥶 #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
Metal is a very good conductor of heat, so a frozen pole pulls heat out of your tongue much faster than wood at the same temperature. The thin film of saliva on your tongue turns to ice in a moment and bonds your tongue to the surface. Wood conducts heat poorly, so the saliva stays liquid and nothing sticks.
